datasources.title: Seven official sources, near real time.
datasources.lead: GitHub Actions cron-driven ETL writes to Supabase nightly. Tools read SQL views — they never hit APIs at runtime.

architecture.title: Architecture that respects the data.
architecture.lead: Nothing of the citizen leaves Paraguay. Federated identity, per-user RLS, Estonian audit trail, auditable models.
architecture.layer1_body: GitHub Actions trigger Python scrapers. Pydantic validates, SHA256 deduplicates.
architecture.layer2_body: Supabase nanduti.* — raw, staging, views. RLS blocks cross-tenant reads.
architecture.layer3_body: Next.js 15 routes 28 tools. Redis cache. Optional MITIC identity.
architecture.layer4_body: DigitalOcean Gradient AI. Haiku 3.5 orchestrates, Sonnet 4 reasons.

footer.manifesto: A digital infrastructure is measured by its respect for the citizen.
footer.demo_note: Institutional demo. Real data, fictitious persona.
